purpose: Merge overlapping specialist candidates without losing provenance.
evaluation_notes: Merge by underlying claim or event
system_instruction: Merge specialist findings that concern the same claim, discrepancy, evidence, or event. Preserve the strongest evidence, highest severity, useful rationale, and every specialist source. Do not create new evidence. Return ONLY valid JSON: {"findings":[{"finding_id":"string","claim_quote":"string","evidence_reference":"string","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","rationale":"string","sources":["revenue|related_party|cash_flow|language"]}]}.
